item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
UFB 1.1.4

  • Windows: right-click freeze fixed. Opening a context menu in the file browser could hang the app (“not responding”) roughly a third of the time when the menu fit neither below nor above the cursor — typically a long menu with the cursor mid-screen on a 1080p display. The menu layout looped forever while the popup was being clamped to the screen. Menus that don’t fit now simply scroll.
  • All menus hardened: every menu in the app (file browser, item list, sidebar, tracker and its submenus, tab menu) now uses a shared UfbMenu that cannot enter that layout loop.
  • Windows: smoother right-click. Checking whether Paste should be enabled no longer asks the clipboard owner to render its data (a busy Explorer, Office, browser or Adobe app could stall UFB for as long as it liked); the check is now instant. The native “Show more options” shell menu no longer blocks the main window while it is open, and can’t deadlock on a chatty shell extension.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
UFB 1.1.3

  • minNotes preview catch-up: the lightbox preview for .mndb documents now renders everything current minNotes writes — choice chips (inline, in table cells, and choice columns), check columns, tri-state task lists, table cell images, cell / row / column colours and alignment, code-block language chips, margin-ink text chips, resizable sketches, and resolved comment threads. Tables take the app's content-measured column widths and wide tables extend past the page column like they do in minNotes.
  • .mnpkg packages preview too: press Space on a minNotes hand-off package and it renders like the document inside it — only the images the document references are unpacked (a multi-GB package with video opens instantly; video, PDF and other attachments show as reference cards).
  • Fixes: margin ink drawn over an image narrower than the page is now placed on the image, not the column; media attachments that can't be opened show a name / path / details card instead of a bare chip.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
UFB 1.1.2

  • Job subscriptions are now personal: subscribing or unsubscribing a job only changes your sidebar and tracker — it no longer adds or removes the job for everyone on the network. Unsubscribe is fully reversible: the job's data keeps syncing to your machine, and resubscribing restores the view instantly.
  • Unsubscribe confirmation: a mis-click can't clear a job from your sidebar anymore — unsubscribing now asks first.
  • Tracker data everywhere: browsing a job you aren't subscribed to now shows its tracked stars and metadata columns — shared tracker data is visible wherever you browse. The All Tracker view stays scoped to your subscribed jobs.
  • Smarter links: opening a ufb:// link into a job you aren't subscribed to now adds it to your sidebar (just for you) and opens the proper job tab, instead of falling back to a plain folder view.
  • Fixes: tracked stars no longer bleed between two open jobs that share a folder name (e.g. two jobs both containing "Shots").
  • Note for fresh installs: the sidebar now starts empty — subscribe to your jobs by browsing to them ("Sync as Job").

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
UFB 1.1.1

  • Metadata safety: removing a job from your sidebar no longer clears that job's shared metadata for every machine on the mesh. Re-subscribing to a job also restores metadata that older versions had hidden this way.
  • Backups: metadata backups of volume-mapped jobs were silently empty — snapshots now capture all columns and items.
  • minNotes previews: Space previews of .mndb documents now render margin ink, sketches, and comment threads, plus text formatting — bold, italic, links, colors, and highlights.
  • Windows previews: html, minNotes, and Markdown previews now render correctly (they could come up blank or open in the browser instead).

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
UFB 1.1.0

  • Rendered HTML previews: Spacebar previews of .html files now render with full CSS and embedded images (Chromium-based) — minNotes exports look like the real thing, complete with the app-styled scrollbar. Links open in your browser.
  • minNotes documents: Space a .mndb file to read it right in the browser — headings, lists, tasks, code, tables, and images render in the minNotes look without opening the app.
  • Audio previews: wav, mp3, aiff, flac, m4a and friends now play in the lightbox with full transport (K/J/L shuttle, seek bar, loop, volume) — same keys as video.
  • Text, code, and logs: Space previews plain text, Markdown, config files, scripts, and code — including extensionless files like README and dotfiles. Huge logs open instantly (first 1 MB shown).
  • More formats: DPX and Cineon frames get thumbnails and full-res previews; svgz joins the image set.
  • Bigger files: thumbnails now up to 256 MP sources; full-res previews scale their memory budget to the machine — gigapixel PSB/TIFF mattes preview on workstation RAM.
  • Requirements: macOS 14 or newer (and builds are now correctly stamped for it).

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
UFB 1.0.12

  • HEIC photos get real thumbnails: iPhone photos (.heic/.heif) now render thumbnails and full lightbox previews on both Windows and macOS, decoded natively via libheif. Multi-tile iPhone captures and EXIF rotation are handled correctly.
  • Renamed iPhone photos too: photos that transfer tooling renamed to .jpg (while leaving HEVC data inside) previously showed no thumbnail at all. UFB now detects the real format from the file contents and previews them regardless of extension.

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
UFB 1.0.11

  • Mounts no longer hang at login (macOS): A mount aimed at a server that isn't reachable yet (VPN still connecting after a restart) could stall forever and never recover. Mount attempts now probe the server first and run under a deadline — an unreachable server fails fast and retries automatically until it comes back.
  • Stale mountpoint "Fix" pill (macOS): When a leftover /Volumes folder from an interrupted mount forces a share onto a "-1" name, the mount row now explains exactly that and offers a one-click Fix… that removes the leftover (one admin prompt) and remounts on the clean name. A genuinely foreign volume occupying the name is still left alone.
  • Sidebar pill clicks: Inline action pills on mount rows (Sign in…, Fix…) could silently ignore clicks — fixed.

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
UFB 1.0.9

  • AE tab — renders/proxies subtabs: After Effects folder tabs now show a subtab strip on the bottom pane, switching between the renders (default) and proxies subfolders. The choice is remembered per folder, and Tracker reveal links open the matching subtab.

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
UFB 1.0.8

  • New update home: updates are now delivered from ufbrowser.com, with downloads hosted on GitHub Releases. This release completes the move — no app-functionality changes.
